title: Krea 3 Topped AI Leaderboards With Research Team of Under 10
summary:
Krea released a technical report detailing the development of its Krea 3 model, providing a comprehensive look at the model's architecture, data pipelines, and training systems. The documentation serves as a guide to the specific techniques the company used to build the system and scale its performance to the top of various AI benchmarks.

The company noted that it achieved its leaderboard results using a research team of under 10 people. The report outlines how the company's lean staffing and training methods allowed it to compete with larger entities in the field.
